synopsis: rFpro is a commercial high-fidelity driving simulator, classified as a complete or near-complete simulation platform, with a particularly detailed camera pipeline [f8518, f8350, f15914]. Its sensor workflows cover image sensors, optics and image signal processing; material dated 29 April 2026 describes full CMOS and ISP modeling and physical validation work [f8549, f8519]. Its focus is automotive and motorsport, and the reviewed evidence is on-road only: no off-road heavy-machine evidence or public off-road validation was found [f8520, f8550, f8521, f15951]. Camera support is documented, but other sensor capabilities, including ultrasonic support, and interfaces and standards were not verified or found [f9042, f8522, f9043, f9090]. Public pricing and a numbered release were not found, although release-related material exists for 2026; these remain procurement and version-identification gaps [f9044, f9045, f9093].
